name: Component impedance (L, C, R)
description: The impedance of an inductor, a capacitor, a resistor or a ferrite with a vector network analyzer (VNA), connected to ground on port 1 (reflection), in series between the ports (series-thru, for high impedances) or from a thru line to ground (shunt-thru, for low impedances): |Z|, R, X, the inductance or capacitance, ESR, Q, the self-resonance, and a check against the nominal value. The transmission methods need only S11 and S21: they work with a forward-only VNA such as the LiteVNA.

roles.name: vna
roles.description: The network analyzer, calibrated at the plane where the component connects (one port for reflection; one port and a thru for series and shunt)

sweep.description: start_hz, stop_hz, points, scale (linear|log), if_bandwidth_hz, power_dbm

device.description: label identifies the component; asset_id is its code in the registry

method.description: reflection (to ground on port 1), series (between the ports) or shunt (from a thru line to ground); series by default

kind.description: auto (guessed from the reactance), inductor, capacitor or resistor

nominal.description: value (H, F or ohm), tolerance_pct (10 by default) and frequency_hz where it is checked

frequencies_of_interest.description: the impedance, the value and Q are reported at these frequencies

z0.description: reference impedance of the VNA (50 by default)

golden.description: check the result against a golden sample of the project (a good unit of the same kind): name or run, and tolerances = {curves: [{trace, view, tolerance}], summary: {figure: tolerance}, min_overlap}

confirm_setup.description: ask, before measuring, to calibrate and connect the component
